record.original_question: Classify normal affine equivariant embeddings of connected solvable linear algebraic groups for which all isotropy groups are semisimple.

evidence.quote: Problem 4. Classify normal affine equivariant embeddings of connected solvable linear algebraic groups for which all isotropy groups are semisimple. It seems to be easy when maximal tori have dimension one.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G$ be a connected solvable linear algebraic group over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero. By an equivariant embedding of $G$ we mean a normal algebraic variety $X$ equipped with a $G$-action together with a $G$-equivariant open embedding of a homogeneous space $G/H$ into $X$ as a dense orbit. Such an embedding is called affine if $X$ is an affine variety.

Problem: Classify, up to $G$-equivariant isomorphism, all normal affine equivariant embeddings $X$ of connected solvable linear algebraic groups $G$ (i.e., embeddings of homogeneous spaces $G/H$ for various closed subgroups $H \subseteq G$) with the property that for every point $x \in X$ the isotropy subgroup $G_x = \{g \in G : g\cdot x = x\}$ is a semisimple algebraic group.

In particular, treat first the case in which a maximal torus of $G$ has dimension one.
artifact.status_search_result: A web search did not turn up a published classification matching this exact problem. Related work on equivariant embeddings of commutative linear algebraic groups of corank one and on spherical/toroidal embeddings of solvable groups exists, but no source confirming a complete classification of normal affine equivariant embeddings of connected solvable linear algebraic groups with semisimple isotropy was located. The current status is therefore unclear.

status_evidence.title: Equivariant embeddings of commutative linear algebraic groups of corank one
status_evidence.snippet: Treats equivariant embeddings of commutative linear algebraic groups of corank one, a related but distinct setting.
status_evidence.claim: Related work addresses embeddings of commutative groups but not the general solvable case with semisimple isotropy.

status_evidence.title: Homogeneous Spaces and Equivariant Embeddings
status_evidence.snippet: Monograph surveying Luna–Vust theory of equivariant embeddings of homogeneous spaces.
status_evidence.claim: Standard reference on equivariant embeddings; does not state a classification for the specific solvable/semisimple-isotropy problem.
